_why: The premade build reaches none of Alonecraft's frost tree. Every talent
the redesign added sits in the defensive columns a raid frost mage skips,
and four of the five are written against Ice Armor -- which no bot ever
cast until this pass, because Ice Armor had no trigger at all.
Convection 3/3       Frostbolt and Blizzard damage build Convective
Currents to 5, empowering Cone of Cold, Frostfire
Bolt and Ice Lance. Ice Lance at the cap heals for
fifteen times its damage. This is the whole of the
woa frost rotation and its only self-heal.
Frozen Core 3/3      Ice Armor's bonus armour scales by 400% of spell
power, which is the single largest mitigation
number available to the spec.
Ablative Armor 3/3   Ice Armor converts intellect and spirit to stamina.
Sublimation 3/3      Ice Armor gains a chance to cut a hit by 90%.
Glacier Armor 2/2    Ice Block heals for 50% over its duration, turning
the panic button into a recovery.
Funded by:
Enduring Winter 3/3  its replenishment is a party buff, and the water
elemental duration it also grants is covered by
Cold Snap.
Arctic Reach 2/2     range. The bot already stands at 30 yards.
Focus Magic, Student of the Mind  1 point each, both solo-dead: Focus
Magic pays back only when a party member crits.
Torment the Weak 3/3 only applies to snared or slowed targets, which is
nearly everything a frost mage fights -- but it sits
on arcane row 3 and costs 5 more points below it to
reach than the 3 it is worth. Dropped, and the
arcane tree stops cleanly at 15.
Chilled to the Bone 5/5 -> 3/5, Winter's Chill 3/3 -> 2/3  the last
three points come off the two flattest damage
multipliers in the tree rather than out of a
rotational or defensive talent.
15 Arcane / 56 Frost.
